title: Attracting and Securing Budgets for Agricultural and Applied Economics Departments
abstract: The aim of this paper is to discuss the challenges in attracting and securing adequate budgets for departments of agricultural and applied economics, while recognizing that the institutional and political contexts matter. Agricultural and applied economics departments that operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, that maintain and grow their student numbers, and that have a vibrant demand for their extension and research activities will thrive. The good news is we often have considerable control over the factors that contribute to our longer‐term success.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在讨论农业与应用经济学系在争取并确保充足预算方面面临的挑战，同时认识到制度和政治背景的重要性。那些以创业精神运作、能够维持并增加学生人数、并且其推广和研究活动拥有旺盛需求的农业与应用经济学系，将会蓬勃发展。好消息是，我们通常对促成长期成功的因素拥有相当大的控制力。

title: Modeling Recreational Amenities in an Urban Setting: Location, Congestion, and Substitution Effects
abstract: In this article, we introduce a recreational amenity—a greenbelt park—into a simple urban economic model. For multiple possible park placements, we solve for the associated equilibrium urban structure, including the equilibrium rent gradient, city boundary, total number of park visits, the overall utility level, and total vehicle miles traveled. We examine how these change with alternative park placement sites. We then show how two modifications of the basic model—allowing congestion at the site to affect site quality, and introducing the possibility of a substitute site at the city's periphery—affect our conclusions about how greenbelt location influences urban structure.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们将一个休闲设施（绿带公园）引入一个简单的城市经济模型。针对多种可能的公园选址，我们求解了相应的均衡城市结构，包括均衡地租梯度、城市边界、公园游览总人次、总体效用水平以及车辆总行驶里程。我们考察了这些变量如何随不同的公园选址而变化。随后，我们展示了对基本模型的两项修改，即允许场地拥堵影响场地质量，以及引入城市外围替代场地的可能性，并分析这些修改如何影响我们关于绿带位置如何影响城市结构的结论。

Are Rural Residents Willing to Pay Enough to Improve Drinking Water Quality?
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: The concentrations of iron and sulfate in community water supplies are a concern for a number of areas in southwestern Minnesota. This study used the contingent valuation method to determine how much consumers would be willing to pay to improve their drinking water quality. On average, individuals were willing to pay US$5.25 per month (in 1995 U.S. dollars) to reduce the level of iron and US$4.33 per month to reduce the level of sulfate in their water to the USEPA's secondary standards for drinking water quality. Respondents with negative perceptions of their drinking water quality were willing to pay more to improve water quality. The aggregate annual willingness to pay (WTP) for all consumers in community water systems in southwestern Minnesota that were out of compliance with water quality standards were estimated to be US$2.4 million and US$2.0 million (in 1995 dollars) for reducing the levels of iron and sulfate, respectively. Yet the total WTP of consumers who use small community water systems may not be enough to pay the full cost of providing improved water in those systems. Economies of scale in water treatment and difficulties in financing improvements mean that technical innovation, government assistance, or institutional changes may be needed to improve water quality in these areas.
abstract_zh: 明尼苏达州西南部的若干地区，社区供水中的铁和硫酸盐浓度令人担忧。本研究采用条件价值评估法，以确定消费者为改善饮用水质量愿意支付多少费用。平均而言，居民愿意每月支付5.25美元（按1995年美元计）以降低水中铁的含量，每月支付4.33美元以降低硫酸盐含量，使其达到美国环保署（USEPA）的饮用水二级标准。对饮用水质量持负面看法的受访者，愿意为改善水质支付更多费用。明尼苏达州西南部社区供水系统中未达到水质标准的所有消费者的年度总支付意愿（WTP），分别估算为降低铁含量240万美元、降低硫酸盐含量200万美元（按1995年美元计）。然而，使用小型社区供水系统的消费者的总支付意愿，可能不足以支付为这些系统提供改善供水的全部成本。水处理中的规模经济以及融资改善工程的困难意味着，要改善这些地区的水质，可能需要技术创新、政府援助或制度变革。

title: Estimating the Benefits of Phosphorus Pollution Reductions: An Application in the Minnesota River
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: In order to make economically efficient decisions about water quality improvements, data on both the costs and benefits of these improvements is needed. However, there has been little research on the benefits of reducing phosphorus pollution which implies that policy decisions are not able to make the comparison of costs and benefits that is essential for economic efficiency. This research attempts to ameliorate this situation by providing an estimate of the benefits of a 40 percent reduction in phosphorus pollution in the Minnesota River. A 1997 mail survey gathered information on Minnesota residents'use of a recreational site on the Minnesota River, the Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge, and their willingness to pay for phosphorus reductions in the Minnesota River. The random effects probit model used in this research to investigate household willingness to pay for phosphorus pollution reductions in the Minnesota River incorporates recent innovations in nonmarket valuation methodology by using both revealed and stated preference data. This model estimated annual household willingness to pay for phosphorus reductions in the Minnesota River at $140. These results may be used in combination with cost estimates to determine the economic efficiency of phosphorus clean up.
abstract_zh: 为了就水质改善做出经济上有效率的决策，需要关于这些改善的成本和效益的数据。然而，关于减少磷污染效益的研究很少，这意味着政策决策无法进行成本效益比较，而这对经济效率至关重要。本研究旨在通过估算将明尼苏达河磷污染减少40%的效益，来改善这一状况。1997年的一项邮寄问卷调查收集了明尼苏达州居民对明尼苏达河上一处休闲场地（明尼苏达河谷国家野生动物保护区）的使用情况，以及他们为减少明尼苏达河磷污染而愿意支付的费用。本研究采用随机效应概率模型来调查家庭为减少明尼苏达河磷污染而愿意支付的费用，该模型同时利用了显示偏好数据和陈述偏好数据，融合了非市场价值评估方法的最新创新。该模型估计，明尼苏达河磷减排的家庭年度支付意愿为140美元。这些结果可与成本估算结合使用，以确定磷污染治理的经济效率。

title: Niches in the Urban Forest: Organizations and Their Role in Acquiring Metropolitan Open Space
abstract: As a response strategy to minimize the impacts of urban sprawl, public and private organizations are striving to acquire open lands that will contribute to a resilient and multifunctional urban forest. In the Chicago metropolitan region, we interviewed representatives of 15 organizations to understand the land acquisition process–the structures and functions of groups involved, their acquisition goals, and the cooperation among groups as they work to build metropolitan green infrastructure. Our findings reveal strength in diversity–a variety of groups working at different levels with complementary goals can help meet the complex challenges of land protection in rapidly urbanizing areas.
abstract_zh: 作为减轻城市蔓延影响的一种应对策略，公共和私人组织正努力获取那些有助于形成具有韧性和多功能的城市森林的开放土地。在芝加哥大都市区，我们访谈了15个组织的代表，以了解土地获取过程，包括参与群体的结构与职能、它们的获取目标，以及各群体在建设大都市绿色基础设施时的合作情况。我们的研究发现，多样性带来优势：不同层级、目标互补的多元群体，有助于应对快速城市化地区土地保护的复杂挑战。

title: Exploring Strategies for Improving the Cost-Effectiveness of Endangered Species Management: The Kirtland's Warbler as a Case Study
The Effects of Minimum Size Limits on Recreational Fishing
Incorporating Environmental Uncertainty into Management Decisions: Kirtland's Warbler Habitat Management as a Case Study
abstract:
We present a framework for expressing species management objectives that incorporates the inherent riskiness of species management strategies. This framework identifies two critical parameters in the management objective: the population level that one would like to achieve and the minimum acceptable probability of attaining that population objective with a given management strategy—the safety margin. We then explore the implications of imposing a management objective in this form on habitat management decisions for the Kirtland’s Warbler (
Dendroica kirtlandii
). We used a stochastic simulation model to generate probability distributions for Kirtland’s Warbler population outcomes under different management strategies. The management parameter we varied was rotation length of commercial logging, and the cost of each rotation length was calculated as the opportunity cost of not operating at the profit‐maximizing rotation length. The cost and warbler population distribution associated with each rotation length were then used to derive cost curves for the two critical decision parameters—population level and safety margin. For most of the range of values analyzed, the relationships between cost and both population objective and safety margin are linear. In addition, the rate at which cost rises with population objective increases as the safety margin required for that objective is raised.
Incorporación de la Incertidumbre Ambiental en Decisiones de Manejo de Especies: El Manejo de Hábitat de
Dendroica kirtlandii
como Caso de Estudio
Presentamos una estructura conceptual para expresar los objetivos de un manejo de especies que incorpore los riesgos inherentes a las estrategias de manejo. Esta estructura identifica dos parámetros cruciales en el objetivo del manejo: el nivel de población que uno podría abarcar y la probabilidad mínima aceptable de alcanzar esa población objetivo con una estrategia de manejo dada (margen de seguridad). Posteriormente exploramos las implicaciones de imponer un objetivo de manejo de esta forma en decisiones de manejo para la curruca de Kirtland (
Dendroica kirtlandii
). Utilizamos un modelo de simulación estocástica para generar las distribuciones de probabilidad para la especie bajo diferentes estrategias de manejo. Variamos el parámetro de manejo “longitud de rotación” en la tala comercial. El costo de cada longitud de rotación fue estimado como el costo de oportunidad por la no operación de la longitud de rotación de máxima ganancia. El costo y la distribución de las currucas asociadas con cada longitud de rotación fueron usados para derivar curvas de costo para los dos parámetros de decisión críticos—nivel de población y margen de seguridad. Para la mayoría del rango de valores analizados, las relaciones entre costo y población objetivo y margen de seguridad fueron lineales. Aunado a esto, la tasa a la cual el costo se incrementa debido a un incremento en la población objetivo, se incrementa cuando el margen de seguridad requerido para ese objetivo también incrementa.
abstract_zh:
我们提出了一个用于表述物种管理目标的框架，该框架纳入了物种管理策略固有的风险性。该框架确定了管理目标中的两个关键参数：人们希望达到的种群水平，以及在给定管理策略下实现该种群目标的最低可接受概率，即安全边际。随后，我们探讨了以这种形式设定管理目标，对柯特兰莺（Dendroica kirtlandii）栖息地管理决策的影响。我们使用随机模拟模型，为柯特兰莺在不同管理策略下的种群结果生成概率分布。我们改变的管理参数是商业采伐的轮伐期，每个轮伐期的成本按偏离利润最大化轮伐期所产生的机会成本计算。随后，利用每个轮伐期的成本和莺类种群分布，推导出两个关键决策参数——种群水平与安全边际——的成本曲线。在所分析的大部分取值范围内，成本与种群目标及安全边际之间的关系均为线性。此外，当对某一目标所要求的安全边际提高时，成本随种群目标上升的速率也随之加快。
环境不确定性纳入物种管理决策：以柯特兰莺栖息地管理为案例研究
我们提出了一个概念框架，用于表述纳入管理策略固有风险的物种管理目标。该框架确定了管理目标中的两个关键参数：希望达到的种群水平，以及在给定管理策略下实现该种群目标的最低可接受概率（安全边际）。随后，我们探讨了以这种形式设定管理目标对柯特兰莺（Dendroica kirtlandii）栖息地管理决策的影响。我们使用随机模拟模型，为不同管理策略下的种群分布生成概率分布。我们改变的管理参数是商业采伐的“轮伐期”长度。每一轮伐期长度的成本，以未在利润最大化轮伐期运作所产生的机会成本估算。随后，利用每一轮伐期的成本及莺类种群分布，推导出两个关键决策参数——种群水平与安全边际——的成本曲线。在所分析的大部分取值范围内，成本与种群目标及安全边际之间的关系均为线性。此外，所要求安全边际的提高，会使成本随种群目标上升的速率加快。
